_comment: Player-facing card data for the channel publisher (tools/publisher.py). Items are matched by exact state.json item name (case-insensitive); an inventory item's own 'mechanics' field (state.py inventory add --mechanics) overrides this. Derived from exports/sheet-*.md. Never put GM-only content here.

cracked phone app (spellbook).mechanics: Spellbook: holds your wizard spells; ritual-cast from it.

pebbles snow globe (driftglobe: light, f.mechanics: Driftglobe (Uncommon wondrous; hand-picked into a Bronze box): within 60 ft, a command word makes it shed the Light cantrip (20 ft bright + 20 ft dim, 1 hour) or Daylight (60 ft bright + 60 ft dim; once per dawn). Another command (Action) floats it up to 5 ft to hover and follow you.

lost-and-found backpack (scholar's pack).mechanics: Scholar's Pack: backpack, book, ink and pen, lamp, 10 oil flasks, parchment, tinderbox.

gas-station gps kit (navigator's tools).mechanics: Tool proficiency kit for plotting a course and navigating.

ziplock pouches.mechanics: Each holds about 6 lb of small items.

discount gas-station jerky cubes (ration.mechanics: Rations: 1 day of food each, 2 lb each.

stolen trailer clothesline (rope 50 ft h.mechanics: Rope, 50 ft: DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check to burst.

expired office first-aid kit (healer's k.mechanics: Healer's Kit: Utilize action to stabilize a creature at 0 HP without a check.

paint-can pry bar (crowbar).mechanics: Crowbar: advantage on Strength checks where leverage helps.

bucket of loose bb pellets (ball bearing.mechanics: Ball Bearings (1000): spill over a 10 ft square; creatures entering make a DC 10 Dex save or fall prone.

gas-station bathroom mirror tile (steel.mechanics: Steel Mirror: look around corners; signal flash.

bike-lock chain missing the lock (chain.mechanics: Chain, 10 ft: 10 HP, DC 20 Strength to burst.

coat-hanger grapple (grappling hook).mechanics: Grappling Hook: attach to rope, throw to anchor on a ledge.

spiked sledgehammer (maul).mechanics: Maul: 2d6 bludgeoning, Heavy, Two-Handed, Topple mastery.

light crossbow + 20 bolts.mechanics: 1d8 piercing, range 80/320, Loading, Two-Handed, Slow mastery.

torches.mechanics: Bright light 20 ft + dim 20 ft, burns 1 hour; 1 fire damage if used as a weapon.

scale mail (steel).mechanics: Medium armor: AC 14 + Dex (max +2), Stealth disadvantage.

sports drink, red flavor (potion of heal.mechanics: Potion of Healing: drink as a Bonus Action, heal 2d4 + 2.

sports drink, blue flavor (potion of hea.mechanics: Potion of Healing: drink as a Bonus Action, heal 2d4 + 2.

laminated complaint card (one-use: syste.mechanics: One use. The System truthfully answers one yes/no question about the current floor.

eternally stained wifebeater (cloak of m.mechanics: Cloak of Many Fashions (Common): Bonus Action to change the garment's style, color and apparent quality.

collapsible tent-pole (pole of collapsin.mechanics: Pole of Collapsing (Common): 10 ft pole; Action command collapses it to 1 ft or extends it back.

gas-station bathroom key on a hubcap (my.mechanics: Opens one specific lock; may vanish after use.

kevin the sentient rubber duck (joke; te.mechanics: Gives terrible advice only. No mechanics.

bone's own chewing tobacco (fan pull).mechanics: Natty Light hologram; the System is listening. No mechanics yet.

rope (50 ft hempen).mechanics: Rope, 50 ft: DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check to burst.

chain (10 ft).mechanics: Chain, 10 ft: 10 HP, DC 20 to burst.

vendor oddity (unappraised).mechanics: House item, no mechanics on Floor 1. Cannot be sold.

Horn.standing_orders: Nearest clear safe room, else follow the closest highest-STR party member.
